name: stitch-design-taste
tagline_zh: AI 界面千篇一律？让它读一份 DESIGN.md，排版、配色、动效全按高级审美校准，连微交互都带呼吸感。
tagline_en: Tired of generic AI UI? One DESIGN.md enforces premium taste—strict type, calibrated color, asymmetric motion.
desc_en: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.
why_zh: 同类只给规则，它给的是「反模板」的审美机制——用不对称布局和持续微动效，逼着模型跳出默认样式。
why_en: Unlike rule lists, it encodes anti-generic taste—asymmetric layouts and perpetual micro-motion force the model off default rails.
